source_policy: Only recorded sources with actual browsed institutional page; preserve distinction statutes/archival descriptions/scholarly abstracts, no imaginary geometry.

records.title: French lands of the English kings

records.title: Letters and papers of Henry VIII

records.title: The Field of Cloth of Gold: Guînes and the Calais Pale Revisited
records.finding: Scholarly pale castle, hydraulic/terrain and surveying history; historical maps do not certify 1530s contemporary boundary without checking year.

records.title: Tudor England's French Frontier: The Laws of Guînes (1529)

records.precision_warning: 1530s on-ground enforcement cannot be inferred from promulgation.

records.title: Siegecraft on the Tudor frontier: the siege of Dublin, 1534, and the crisis of the Kildare rebellion
records.finding: Summer and autumn 1534 Kildare rebel siege failed to seize Dublin and king's castle.

records.title: The Wizard Earl of Kildare

records.title: Dublin Castle
records.institution: Office of Public Works / Heritage Ireland

records.precision_warning: Modern Dublin Castle structure extensively altered, not 1534 walls.

records.title: Laws in Wales Act 1535, 27 Henry VIII c.26
records.finding: Incorporates Wales into English administrative legal system and places marcher lordships into listed shires.
records.precision_warning: Regnal/sessional dating 1535, often described as 1536 enactment. Do not mistake for newly conquered sovereign Wales; no ancient polygons extracted.

records.title: Laws in Wales Act 1542 (34 & 35 Hen. 8 c.26)
records.finding: The second Laws in Wales Act is dated 1542, not the 1530s; prevent anachronistic inclusion.
records.precision_warning: Reference to dating only; not direct read of the 1542 act.

records.title: Dissolution of the monasteries 1536–1540
records.finding: Archive series E344, E346, E322, LR1/LR2, SP1/SP5; 1536–39 Crown asset acquisition and fiscal management.
records.precision_warning: Religious estates are an asset/finance layer, not overseas colonial territorial sovereignty. No location-specific holdings mapped yet.

records.title: The dissolution of the monasteries: original document examples
records.finding: 1534 C65/143 Act, 1535 E344/22 ecclesiastical revenue valuation; 1538 E322/39 Bisham surrender; June 1538 E101/459/22 Chertsey dismantling expenses.

records.title: Chronicles of the Dissolution, Piety Plunder and Protest transcript

records.title: Artillery Defences, HEAG197

records.precision_warning: Fortresses inside English kingdom, not English colonial new land.

records.title: Archcliffe Fort, Dover scheduled monument 1016420
records.finding: New artillery works 1539–40 at Dover; historic fort phases not identical to modern bastions.
records.precision_warning: Exact modern structures largely later phases.

records.title: History of Deal Castle

records.title: History of Portland Castle
records.finding: Portland Castle under construction in 1539–40.
records.precision_warning: Do not mark full operational readiness in 1539 without further document.

records.title: History of Hurst Castle

records.precision_warning: 1539 general defence programme does not date each specific fort's construction to 1539.

records.title: Linlithgow Palace: history

records.precision_warning: Not English realm; historical castle positions not national borders.

records.precision_warning: Scottish sovereign works not evidence England controlled castle.

records.title: Tantallon Castle: history

records.title: 1536 English Newfoundland voyage archival verification queue

records.title: Treason and dissimulation in the Henrician Reformation: Leonard Grey and the polarisation of politics in the Irish Pale, 1534–40
records.institution: Irish Historical Studies / Cambridge University Press
records.finding: First Irish Reformation parliament session began 1 May 1536; six initial acts, including royal headship over Irish Church. Complex Irish Pale factional politics.
records.precision_warning: Date of session and statute year differ; parliamentary claim to jurisdiction over island not evidence of effective territorial governance.

records.title: Statute Rolls of the Irish Parliament: Richard III to Henry VIII
records.institution: Four Courts Press / editor Philomena Connolly
records.finding: 1536–37 Irish Reformation Parliament enacted supremacy, reform administration and began religious land appropriation; surviving roll used by critical editor.
records.precision_warning: Original 1536–37 roll/critical edition not directly examined; cannot draw administrative boundaries without parish details.

records.title: Poynings' Law
records.finding: English royal influence on Irish parliament by Poynings Law and 1536 reformation legislation; Lord of Ireland until 1541 kingdom title.
records.precision_warning: Irish island not all crown tax/enforcement zone in 1530s, kingdom title dated 1541 outside period.

records.title: Ireland's English Pale, 1470–1550
records.finding: 1537–38 commission found Offaly could be captured more readily than held; needed forts and settlers to keep land. Evidence against automatic permanent occupation polygons.
records.precision_warning: Chronicle paraphrase not new exact cadastral map; period-specific military actual control extent uncertain.

records.title: Henry VIII, rebellion and the rule of law
records.institution: University of Galway research repository / Steven G. Ellis
records.finding: Detailed May 1536 act taking Crown back manor of Leixlip amid Geraldine forfeitures; source cites Irish Parliament roll c.11 and letters/papers.
records.precision_warning: Verify act folios and manor boundaries before drawing solid estate land polygon; manor not whole Kildare County.

records.title: Chronology of Key Events in Irish History 1169 to 1799
records.finding: 1536 Kildare earldom estate confiscation; Irish 1536 supremacy; 1540 surrender-and-regrant, 1541 King of Ireland outside decade.
records.precision_warning: Summary chronology not parcel boundaries or original documentary proof.

records.precision_warning: Published edition not new original 1536 manuscript; 155MB scans not fetched, copyright uncertain.

records.title: 'Wilde shamrock manners': anglicisation and the politics of gesture in early modern Ireland

records.title: Leixlip chronology 1500–1549, local archival transcription
records.finding: Records 1537 act for Leixlip manor and 1538/39 local royal grants; quotes 1861 edited historical patent and close rolls.
records.precision_warning: This source dates Leixlip act 1537 while Ellis scholarly analysis dates some royal resumption measure 1536. Must resolve statute-roll session/regnal dating before pinning year.

records.title: Edward Hall, The Union of the Two Noble and Illustre Families of Lancastre and Yorke, 1532 entries
records.institution: Edward Hall contemporary Tudor chronicle, transcription All About History
records.finding: On 11 Oct 1532 English king landed at Calais, surveyed walls/bulwarks; French king entered 25 Oct via Newenham Bridge/Rysbank/Mill Gate. City and outworks evidenced as actual defended locations.
records.read_scope: Hall chronicle edited online transcription read, not original 1548 printing pages
records.precision_warning: Date details chronicle vs other contemporaneous accounts vary 15/16 October for French embassies; no historic fortress polygons; 1532 French monarch VISITING Calais is not French military rule.

records.title: Field of Cloth of Gold: 1532 second meeting at Calais
records.finding: Henry VIII and Francis I met again at Calais in 1532; Calais and nearby Guînes English Crown control continuity.
records.precision_warning: English-held Calais context, but 1532 court visit doesn't give Pale parish outer border.

records.title: Les fortifications anglaises de Guînes au XVIe siècle (1536 engineer / 1541 plan)

records.precision_warning: The 1541 image is NOT a measured polygon of all 1530s Calais Pale. Do not backdate the 1541 plan to 1536 or copy licensed historic image.

records.title: Un document exceptionnel : une carte du Calaisis sous la domination anglaise de 1346 à 1558

records.read_scope: chapter indexed image/text; original map NOT opened
records.precision_warning: Dating to the year 1530 unverified. Source for further archival work, not instant exact boundaries.

records.title: Laws in Wales Act 1535 (27 Henry VIII c.26) sections on marcher lordship county annexation

records.read_scope: official source table of contents; not full clause-by-clause original manuscript
records.precision_warning: Legal shire names are verifiable, their original sixteenth-century polygons NOT. Statute Year 1535; familiar 1536 execution requires distinction.

records.title: Laws in Wales Act 1535 complete historical transcription
